title.en: Alternator does not replace what B500S-83D vs Electric 15 Concrete Pump lists
title.zh: 「交流發電機」不能替换B500S-83D和电动15混凝土泵有何不同列出的数字

description.en: B500S-83D vs Electric 15 Concrete Pump. 7.5 kW stays in the catalogue entry. Illustration: Alternator.
description.zh: B500S-83D和电动15混凝土泵有何不同。7.5 kW仍在目录格子里。插图来自「交流發電機」。

h1.en: Alternator does not replace what B500S-83D vs Electric 15 Concrete Pump lists
h1.zh: 「交流發電機」不能替换B500S-83D和电动15混凝土泵有何不同列出的数字

directAnswer.en: B500S-83D and Electric 15 are compact concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. B500S-83D lists 7.5 kW, 380 V, materials sand and small stone 5–16 mm, a short boom that is not a truck placing boom, and 280 kg. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alternator.
directAnswer.zh: B500S-83D 和电动15是河北品锦机械在邢台的紧凑型混凝土泵。B500S-83D 标出 7.5 kW、380 V、适用材料为砂与小石 5–16 mm、本机短臂架而非车载布料杆，以及 280 kg。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alternator。

body.en: The figure is the one published at https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alternator: Alternator. B500S-83D and Electric 15 are compact concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Motor power: B500S-83D lists 7.5 kW. Electric 15 lists 15 kW. These are shown entries on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance.
body.zh: 这张图是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alternator页上的Alternator。B500S-83D 和电动15是河北品锦机械在邢台的紧凑型混凝土泵。垂直输送高度：B500S-83D标出 5 m；电动15标出 15–20 m。B500S-83D有、电动15没有的行：型式 Two-stage structure pump, manual / electric；额定电压 380 V；臂架行 Short boom on the compact unit, not a truck-mounted placing boom；适用材料 Sand and small stone, 5–16 mm；输送胶管 Standard。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。

body.en: B500S-83D lists 7.5 kW, 380 V, materials sand and small stone 5–16 mm, a short boom that is not a truck placing boom, and 280 kg. Vertical delivery height: B500S-83D lists 5 m. Electric 15 lists 15–20 m. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other. The only catalogue line that uses the word boom is the B500S-83D short-boom note. If a job needs a figure this pair does not list, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: B500S-83D 标出 7.5 kW、380 V、适用材料为砂与小石 5–16 mm、本机短臂架而非车载布料杆，以及 280 kg。水平输送距离：B500S-83D标出 5 m；电动15标出 60–80 m。电动15有、B500S-83D没有的行：理论输送量 8–10 m³/h；最大骨料粒径 1–3 cm；输送管内径 100–125 mm；整机重量 450 kg。如果工况需要这对机型没有写出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

body.en: Electric 15 lists 15 kW, 8–10 m³/h, aggregate 1–3 cm, pipe 100–125 mm and 450 kg. Horizontal delivery distance: B500S-83D lists 5 m. Electric 15 lists 60–80 m. B500S-83D lists entries that Electric 15 does not: Type Two-stage structure pump, manual / electric. Rated voltage 380 V. Boom line Short boom on the compact unit, not a truck-mounted placing boom. Applicable materials Sand and small stone, 5–16 mm. Delivery hose Standard. Open /en/products/b500s-83d-two-stage-pump/ for B500S-83D and /en/products/electric-15-concrete-pump/ for Electric 15.
body.zh: 电动15标出 15 kW、8–10 m³/h、骨料 1–3 cm、管径 100–125 mm、450 kg。外形尺寸：B500S-83D标出 915 × 550 × 550 mm；电动15标出 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm。目录里使用臂架一词的，是 B500S-83D 的短臂架说明。

body.en: The short boom line does not appear on Electric 15. Dimensions: B500S-83D lists 915 × 550 × 550 mm. Electric 15 lists 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm. Electric 15 lists entries that B500S-83D does not: Theoretical output 8–10 m³/h. Max. aggregate size 1–3 cm. Delivery pipe diameter 100–125 mm. Total weight 450 kg. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei.
body.zh: 电机功率：B500S-83D标出 7.5 kW；电动15标出 15 kW。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上写出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。看B500S-83D请打开 /zh/products/b500s-83d-two-stage-pump/，看电动15请打开 /zh/products/electric-15-concrete-pump/。

question.en: Does B500S-83D list the same motor power as Electric 15?
question.zh: B500S-83D和电动15的电机功率一样吗？

answer.en: No. B500S-83D lists 7.5 kW. Electric 15 lists 15 kW. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alternator.
answer.zh: 不一样。B500S-83D标出 7.5 kW。电动15标出 15 kW。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alternator画面里印出的数字。

answer.en: No. B500S-83D lists 5 m. Electric 15 lists 60–80 m. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alternator.

question.en: On this row: Why is type missing on Electric 15?

answer.en: The Electric 15 page does not list that label. B500S-83D lists Two-stage structure pump, manual / electric. Leave the missing entry blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alternator.
answer.zh: 电动15这一页没有标出这个标题。B500S-83D标出的是 Two-stage structure pump, manual / electric。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alternator画面里印出的数字。
